title: Hanner-Hydra: multiplication-free competing kernels from Hanner polytopes for time series classification
description:
Code for Hanner-Hydra, a variant of the Hydra time series classifier in which each group of competing convolutional kernels is the vertex set of a Hanner polytope. The vertices are ternary and the support function follows the cotree of the polytope, so the winner of a group with up to 2ℓ vertices costs ℓ absolute values and ℓ−1 additions or comparisons, with no multiplication.

The repository contains the NumPy reference implementation, the Numba kernels (tested to reproduce the reference bit for bit), aeon-compatible estimators, the pre-registration of the primary endpoint, and every experiment, analysis and paper-table script. The per-case benchmark results are published separately under CC BY 4.0 (GitHub release results-v1).
